onboarding.welcomeBody: No account, no email, no password. Your data stays on this device until you decide otherwise.
onboarding.nicknameWhy: Used inside the app only. It becomes visible to others if you ever share a Space.

incomeDriven.name: Regular income
incomeDriven.body: For a household or personal budget with regular income. Periods run automatically from one payday to the next, and one-off receipts add to your free money.

budget.name: Budget
budget.body: For a goal or an event with a limit on money, a date, or both. Set the budget, record what you spend, and see whether you fit.
budget.examples: A trip, a renovation, an office purchase.

flow.name: Flow
flow.body: For irregular income, or when you simply want to see spending ahead. Counts from the money you have now: how far it reaches and what is left.
flow.examples: Freelance, living on savings, open-ended planning.

local.name: Local
local.body: Stored on this device only. Fast, fully private, works without a network. It will not appear on another device and cannot be shared.

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.notYet: Not available in this version yet.

space.firstBody: A Space holds one budget. Separate ones keep separate things apart — a household, a trip, freelance work.
space.modeIsPermanent: Chosen once. The three types compute money differently, so a Space keeps the one it was created with.
space.currencyFreezes: Can be changed until the first record is added.
space.currencyFrozen: Frozen — this Space already has records.
space.archiveConfirm: "{title}" disappears from the switcher. Its records stay on this device and nothing is deleted.
space.archiveBody: Archiving hides the Space without deleting anything.

balance.sheetBody: The money you actually have right now. Expenses already paid on or before today are left out of the forecast so they are not counted twice.

payment.dateOutOfRange: That date is unusually far away. Saving it is allowed.
payment.mandatoryConfirmBody: Mandatory payments are real obligations. Continue?

series.title: This payment repeats
series.body: Which occurrences should the change apply to? Occurrences already marked paid are never changed.

income.amountRequired: An amount is needed to mark this received.

category.title: Categories
category.titleFrozen: The name is fixed: payments are already filed under it. Colour and type stay editable.
category.deleteBody: Payments filed under "{title}" keep its name, but it can no longer be chosen for new ones.

calendar.notYet: The calendar arrives in a later version.

coverage.short: Not covered before the next income

decryption.title: Your data cannot be opened
decryption.body: The database is on this device, but the key that unlocks it is gone. This usually happens after clearing app data or moving to a new device.
decryption.notYetAvailable: Not available in this version yet
decryption.confirmBody: The database stays unreadable without the key. Starting over deletes it and opens onboarding. This cannot be undone.
